stemMd: Ten students have a mean score of 72 and fifteen have a mean score of 82. What is the mean for all 25 students?
explanationMd: The combined score total is 10 times 72 plus 15 times 82=1950. Dividing by 25 gives 78. An unweighted average of the two means would ignore unequal group sizes.
